messages:
june_sales: FYI - Skylark returned MSA/DPA redlines and said procurement will issue a PO before countersigning Order Form. Key asks: Net45, PO must reference OF# SK-2026-88, auditor access language, and HSM clause. POC blocked until PO arrives.

max_ops: If we provision on PO-only ops needs PO PDF, billing contact, and a signed acknowledgement of a short provisional addendum. We'll lock retention to 14d and disable exports.

tara_legal: I'll draft a "Provisional Access Addendum" (30 days) that limits audit scope to portal log extracts, caps liability to trial credit, and expires if MSA unsigned. Won't accept broad auditor rights. Can upload redline today.

rob_fin: Finance will accept PO as trigger if it references the OF and includes billing entity + tax id. Otherwise require prepay or a capped trial credit. Ask customer to send PO PDF to billing@redwood.com.

sana_sec: Security: SOC2 summary ready. No public HSM attestation today. For POC we'll offer KMS placeholder and enforce 14d retention + no exports. HSM route is Private deployment (~2-3w).

june_sales: Customer says PO will be sent today and will reference OF-SK-2026-88. They're okay with the provisional addendum if concise. I'll post PO PDF and billing contact when received.

max_ops: Ops ETA 4 business days after PO + billing + addendum ack. Will enforce the ops checklist in the addendum's Exhibit A.

tara_legal: Action items: I'll upload addendum redline; Rob -> confirm billing template; Sana -> attach SOC2 summary; June -> get PO PDF and billing contact.

june_sales: Uploaded PO PDF (PO# SK-2026-88). Billing contact: accounts@skylark.co. Customer acknowledged provisional addendum via email. Proceeding with provisioning slot request.
